harness_auth.measured: brokkr driver exec runs the command its bundle names with the seat's bindings and contacts no provider; the only variable it reads is BROKKR_EXEC_NAME, its label (crates/brokkr-protocol/src/adapters.rs, the AdapterKind::Exec invocation arm), so it reads no authentication name

mcp.inapplicable: exec runs the script its bundle names and serves no model, so it has no model MCP surface; this is neither a measured strictness nor a missing measurement (U0, exec: docs/evidence/adapters/slice-two-mcp-isolation.md)

native_capabilities.unmeasured: exec runs whatever command the bundle names; the engine cannot certify what an arbitrary child program reaches on its own, so its native inventory is unmeasured. Its hands, boundary and command authority are decisions 0043 and 0046's, unchanged
